## DNOW Announces Fourth Quarter and Full-Year 2025 Earnings Conference Call


February 17, 2026


[PDF Version](https://ir.dnow.com/node/12496/pdf)


HOUSTON--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Feb. 17, 2026-- DNOW Inc. (NYSE:DNOW) has scheduled a conference call to discuss the results for the fourth quarter and full-year 2025 on **Friday, February 20, 2026 at 8:00 am (US Central Time).** Financial results for the fourth quarter and the year ending December 31, 2025 are expected to be released that morning before the market opens.


The call will be broadcast through the Investor Relations link on DNOW’s web site at[ir.dnow.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.dnow.com%2F&esheet=54426505&newsitemid=20260217788263&lan=en-US&anchor=ir.dnow.com&index=1&md5=88ba6b8eb8bf1f0806038f5385bff2c0) on a listen-only basis. Listeners should log in prior to the start of the call to register for the webcast. A replay of the call will be available online for thirty days following the conference. Participants may also join the conference call by dialing **1-888-660-6431** **within North America** or **1-929-203-2118** **outside of North America, Access Code: 7372055,** fifteen minutes prior to the scheduled start time and asking for the “DNOW Earnings Conference Call.”


DNOW is a premier energy and industrial solutions provider with a legacy of over 160 years as a leading distributor of pipe, valves, fittings (PVF), gas products, pumps and fabricated equipment. Headquartered in Houston, Texas, with approximately 5,300 employees and a global network of distribution and engineering locations; we provide a broad mix of quality products our customers require to build and maintain essential infrastructure across the upstream, midstream, gas utilities, downstream, energy evolution and industrial markets. We deliver a comprehensive range of value-added supply chain solutions and technical product expertise, supported by advanced digital offerings. Our products and resources enable our customers to run their operations more efficiently and effectively, helping them to meet and exceed their business goals. For more information, visit us at[www.dnow.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fnam11.safelinks.protection.outlook.com%2F%3Furl%3Dhttp%253A%252F%252Fwww.dnow.com%252F%26data%3D05%257C02%257CRaymond.Chang%2540dnow.com%257Ca13a7113e4544133664008de6d7d3f5a%257Cce23078f982548f3bf5b484e654e2128%257C0%257C0%257C639068581856911578%257CUnknown%257CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%253D%253D%257C4000%257C%257C%257C%26sdata%3Dj3nBGTxII4C7%252B5DP%252FNQwiZ63mn4I7%252FDqo7auWb1BdAk%253D%26reserved%3D0&esheet=54426505&newsitemid=20260217788263&lan=en-US&anchor=www.dnow.com&index=2&md5=ff27a81be2d3373a22048ee4482af617) .
